name: NREL 5-MW reference wind turbine blade - geometry, airfoils and distributed structural properties (reference model, no measurement)

circle.polar_source: Jonkman 2009 Cylinder1: cl = 0, cd = 0.50 (as defined by the reference model, not the README's 1.0-1.2)

du40.polar_source: DU 00-W2-401, Jonkman 2009 table DU40_A17 (DOWEC 2D data, AirfoilPrep 3D stall delay + Viterna), OpenFAST r-test

experiments.validates: order-of-magnitude/consistency check of the section model on a real (composite) blade: with an equivalent density and wall thickness (derived_equivalent_homogeneous.csv) the program's A*rho should follow mass_per_length; reference input for a future deflection/frequency solver
experiments.conditions: reference-model data, composite blade - a homogeneous section reproduces it only with fitted rho/E/wall
experiments.source: Jonkman et al. 2009, NREL/TP-500-38060, Table 2-1 (p. 5), tabulated; identical to the OpenFAST r-test ElastoDyn/BeamDyn blade files
experiments.uncertainty: tabulated (exact); the model data themselves are design estimates (DOWEC), not measurements

experiments.validates: blade mass and centrifugal root force summation of Calculator.statical_analysis (lumped section mass at element centres) when fed mass_per_length x 1.04536
experiments.conditions: 17 elements of geometry.csv (r_m, dr_m); omega for the centrifugal row 12.1 rpm (rated), no precone
experiments.source: Jonkman et al. 2009, Table 2-2 (p. 6), tabulated; integrations by extraction/build_case.py

experiments.validates: information only (derived here): solid-section A/Ix/Iy of the real airfoil outlines at the real chords, and the equivalent homogeneous density/modulus/shell wall that reproduce Table 2-1
experiments.source: derived by extraction/build_case.py from geometry.csv, airfoils/*.dat and Table 2-1

sources.citation: Jonkman, J., Butterfield, S., Musial, W., Scott, G. (2009). Definition of a 5-MW Reference Wind Turbine for Offshore System Development. NREL/TP-500-38060.
OpenFAST r-test regression test models, glue-codes/openfast/5MW_Baseline (ElastoDyn, BeamDyn and AeroDyn blade files, Airfoils/*), main branch fetched 2026-10-18.

notes: geometry.csv is Table 3-1 (17 element centres from the apex, element lengths dr_m sum to 61.5 m; root 1.5 m, tip 63 m). Twist = AeroTwst = chord angle to the rotor plane at zero pitch (solver convention, no conversion). The real rotor has 2.5 deg precone and 5 deg shaft tilt (Jonkman Table 1-1) - not modelled by the program. Rated: 11.4 m/s, 12.1 rpm (Table 1-1); the blade pitch schedule above rated is in Jonkman Table 7-1 (not copied). Table 2-1 mass_per_length is as tabulated; the reference model multiplies it by 1.04536 (AdjBlMs) to reach the 17,740 kg blade mass. Polars are the model's own 3D-corrected tables (stored -20..30 deg; full +-180 tables in sources/openfast_r-test). EI_flap/EI_edge are about principal axes turned by the structural twist (= aero twist). No measured data exist for this turbine - the case is a reference for consistency/order of magnitude, not a validation of absolute accuracy.
